modules.title: Image
modules.summary: Image generation and editing with Qwen, Z-Image and FLUX.3 (ComfyUI).

modules.title: Video
modules.summary: FreeVideo H3, Wan 2.2 and character speech; also provides export and the sound mixer.

modules.title: Music
modules.summary: ACE-Step 1.5, MiniMax Music3 and Stable Audio 3.

modules.title: Text
modules.summary: Private chat model through a separate Ollama.

modules.title: Voice input
modules.summary: Speech recognition for the microphone buttons in every text field.

software-only.title: Only the programs, no models (download models later)

light.title: Light: smaller models of every section

components.title: 7-Zip console unpacker (7zr.exe)
components.description: Small official 7-Zip tool, used only to unpack the ComfyUI archive.

components.title: ComfyUI 0.42.1 portable (NVIDIA): the Image engine
components.description: ComfyUI with its own embedded Python and PyTorch. Runs the Image section and its workflows.

components.title: Qwen Image Edit 2511 (FP8) with LoRA
components.description: Editing one image, editing with a reference image, or a prompt on a neutral canvas.

components.title: Qwen Image 2.1 Uncensored (FP8)
components.description: Native text-to-image plus editing with reference images.
components.note: Uncensored community quantization; use responsibly and within your local law.

components.title: Z-Image Turbo (INT8)
components.description: Fast text-to-image only: no editing and no reference images.

components.title: FLUX.3 Klein distilled (INT8) with prompt upsampler
components.description: Text-to-image, single-image editing and editing with a reference image; the official Qwen3.5 prompt upsampler writes the detailed caption.
components.license: FLUX Kommunity License v1.0 (model); Apache-2.0 (text encoder, upsampler)
components.note: LICENSE CHECK: non-commercial use, or commercial use of outputs only as a Qualifying User (gross annualized revenue under US$5M) with content filtering or output review. Accept the terms of black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy on Hugging Face and give the installer a read token as HF_TOKEN. Read Models/Image/FLUX3-Klein/LICENSE.md.

components.title: Real-ESRGAN x2 (upscaling)
components.description: Separate 2x/4x picture upscaling.

components.title: Video runtime: Python 3.12, PyTorch (CUDA 13), FreeVideo, ComfyUI-native Wan, ffmpeg
components.description: What the Video section and MiniMax Music run on: an isolated Python with PyTorch and SageAttention, the pinned FreeVideo / VDN / ComfyUI sources, ffmpeg 9.0.2 and the voice packages.
components.license: Open-source components, each under its own license (see Support/Licenses)

components.title: FreeVideo H3 (MiniMax H3 INT8): text and image to video with sound
components.description: The main Video engine: 512x288 clips of 1.6 or 10 seconds with sound, up to three character references, speech and a 60-second multi-scene option.
components.license: Model: OpenVDN / MiniMax H3 license (text is downloaded into Models/Video/H3/LICENSE); code: Apache-2.0
components.note: LICENSE CHECK: the MiniMax H3 Community License limits its territory and excludes the European Union, the United Kingdom, South Korea and the United States. Read Models/Video/H3/LICENSE before using this model.

components.title: Qwen3-TTS 0.6B (character speech, voice cloning)
components.description: Speech for FreeVideo characters from a 2 to 30 second voice sample and typed lines.

components.title: UMT5-XXL text encoder (shared by both Wan models)
components.description: Text encoder used by Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B and Wan 2.2 S2V-14B; downloaded once.

components.title: Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B: text/image to video (silent)
components.description: Silent 832x480 video from text or from a first image (81 or 121 frames).

components.title: Wan 2.2 S2V-14B: character video from a voice (experimental)
components.description: A character picture plus a voice sample (or finished speech) becomes a 512x512 talking video of up to 4.8 seconds.

components.title: Music runtime: Python 3.12 (embeddable), PyTorch CUDA 12.8, ACE-Step 1.5 code
components.description: Isolated Windows Python with PyTorch and the pinned ACE-Step 1.5 sources, plus the Microsoft C++ runtime DLLs unpacked from the signed official package (no system-wide install).
components.license: MIT (ACE-Step); Python PSF; Microsoft VC++ runtime redistributable terms

components.title: ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo (2B) with the 0.6B planner
components.description: Songs from lyrics or instrumentals, 10 to 180 seconds, 48 kHz stereo WAV.

components.title: MiniMax Music3 INT8 (songs with vocals)
components.description: A second Music engine: 32 kHz stereo WAV, up to 60 seconds. Runs on the Video runtime.
components.license: MiniMax Music3 Community License (read the LICENSE file)
components.note: Read the LICENSE file that is downloaded with the model: it is a community license with its own conditions.

components.title: Stable Audio 3 Medium (music and sound effects)
components.description: Music and sound effects from an English description: 44.1 kHz stereo WAV, 10 to 120 seconds. Runs in the Image ComfyUI.
components.license: Stability AI Community License; Gemma Terms of Use (text encoder)
components.note: LICENSE CHECK: the Stability AI Community License limits commercial use (see Models/Music/StableAudio3/LICENSE.md and stability.ai/license); the T5Gemma text encoder is under the Gemma Terms of Use, https://ai.google.dev/gemma/terms. Using the model means accepting both; the package itself is public and needs no token.

components.title: Ollama 0.33.3 (private copy for the Text section)
components.description: A separate copy of Ollama used only by VisualForge (own port, own model folder). It never touches an Ollama you installed yourself. AMD ROCm libraries are left out.

components.title: Gemma 4 E2B (small, vision)
components.description: Fits comfortably on 8 GB cards.
components.license: Gemma terms of use / Apache-2.0 (see the model license shown by Ollama)

components.title: Gemma 4 E4B (recommended, vision)
components.description: Good quality for 12-16 GB cards.
components.license: Gemma terms of use / Apache-2.0 (see the model license shown by Ollama)

components.title: Gemma 4 26B (large, vision)
components.description: Needs about 16 GB of video memory; the biggest option.
components.license: Gemma terms of use / Apache-2.0 (see the model license shown by Ollama)

components.title: Whisper large-v3-turbo (recommended)
components.description: Fast and accurate speech recognition for Russian and about 90 other languages, used by the microphone buttons. About 1.6 GB.

components.title: Whisper small (light)
components.description: Smaller and faster, good for a processor-only computer; less accurate with names and noise. About 1 GB.

components.title: Whisper large-v3 (most accurate)
components.description: The most accurate of the three, slower and heavier (about 3.1 GB); best with a video card.

components.title: RUPunct big (punctuation and capitals for Russian)
components.description: Turns "доктор пеппер вертолет летает" into a properly written sentence: capital letters, commas, full stops, question marks. Used automatically after recognition when installed. About 0.7 GB.

components.title: LTX 2.5 Distilled · видео со звуком
components.description: Локальная генерация по тексту или изображению. INT8 ConvRot, 24 FPS; быстрый и двухпроходный профили.
components.note: Перед скачиванием примите условия Lightricks/LTX-2.5 на Hugging Face. Установщику нужен HF_TOKEN с правом чтения. При генерации сеть и токен не нужны.
